items: **[Feb]** Rashid Khan — first bowler to reach 700 T20 wickets; Harmanpreet Kaur — highest-capped woman in international cricket; PM Modi crossed 100 million Instagram followers — most-followed world leader
**[Jan]+[Feb]** Virat Kohli — 2nd-highest run-scorer internationally (Jan) + remains most-followed Indian on Instagram (Feb)
**[Jan]** Nirmala Sitharaman — set to present her 9th Budget in a row, longest-serving FM — 🔄 pairs directly with the Budget 2026-27 cluster (Section 1)

**[Mar]** Gukesh Dommaraju returns to World No. 10 chess (FIDE calculation-error correction); Lionel Messi — 2nd men's footballer to 900 official goals (after Ronaldo's 965); LeBron James breaks NBA's most-games-played record (1,612th game); Sunil Narine (KKR) — IPL's most-capped overseas player (190 caps); India — first team to qualify for 4 Men's T20 WC finals; Bhupathiraju Anmish Varma — Guinness World Record, fastest Seven Volcanic Summits climb (92 days); NMDC — India's 1st mining company to produce 50 million tonnes iron ore in a single FY; India — world's largest coconut producer (30.37% global output); **PM Modi — longest-serving elected head of government in the country (8,931 days)**, surpassing Pawan Chamling's 8,930-day Sikkim CM tenure; India hits 1 billion tonnes coal production for 2nd consecutive year; **Gujarat** becomes 2nd state (after Uttarakhand) to pass a Uniform Civil Code bill; Jawed Ashraf — first Indian Ambassador to receive France's Legion of Honour (Commandeur); Natarajan Chandrasekaran (Tata Group Chairman) — honorary UK knighthood

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Sitharaman's "9th Budget in a row" + PM Modi's 8,931-day milestone are the two standalone highest-recall Persons-in-News facts across the quarter.
